text:
Priya Desai: Morning team — quick desk spotlight before handoff. current snapshot: 24 open tickets, 3 high-priority (customer-impacting), backlog up 12% vs yesterday. Anyone seeing traffic spikes?

Ben Cole: saw a small surge from EU region around 02:10 UTC, mostly auth errors on the webhook consumer. not a full-blown outage, but 6 tickets so far.

Marta Liu: I picked up two of the webhook auths, looks like token rotation failed for one org (expired cert). rolled a hotfix to revalidate and queue retries — marking in the tickets.

Alex R.: For context on the expired cert: downstream vendor rotated keys yesterday; I sent the vendor a support bundle. flagged one ticket for escalation if we see >5 repeats.

Priya Desai: Thanks. Macros update: I pushed a new macro for the webhook retry flow named "webhook-retry-guidance-v3" — please start using that for the auth ones. snippet below for copy/paste: 

```
Hi {{customer}},
Thanks for the report — we've identified an expired token on your integration. We've queued a retry and recommended steps: 1) confirm vendor key rotation, 2) re-run connection from your UI, 3) share the logs if it persists. Temporary retries scheduled at t+5m,t+15m.
If the issue continues we'll escalate to Platform.
```

Samir Patel: thumbs up on the macro. Quick Q: should we also add an escalation tag for dedicated customers?

Priya Desai: yes — add `[ESCALATE:DEDICATED]` at the top for Dedicated accounts. I'll update the macro after handoff.

Ben Cole: separate note — embeddings ingestion pipeline showing higher retry rates (around 10% -> 18%) for long documents. it's creating duplicate tickets. I disabled the automatic ticket creation for that alert to reduce noise; kept one aggregate ticket.

Marta Liu: good call. any known root cause?

Ben Cole: initial guess is a recent model update changed chunking behavior; the dedupe logic uses exact IDs so minor chunk reshuffle leads to perceived failures. infra is investigating.

Alex R.: tagging eng-ml and eng-runtime in the aggregate ticket. @eng-ml please triage model changes, @eng-runtime please check KV cache behavior.

Priya Desai: Operational asks for the shift:
- Ben: please keep the aggregate ticket updated and add a short note in the macro if we expect duplicates.
- Marta: finish the webhook auth escalations and link the updated macro.
- Samir: monitor the Dedicated queue for any repeat auths (esp orgs with reserved capacity).
- Alex: can you confirm vendor reply ETA in the webhook ticket?

Samir Patel: on it — I'll watch Dedicated queue for next 2 hours.

Marta Liu: I'll have the escalations done and macro link posted within 20m.

Ben Cole: I'll push a short comment to the aggregate embeds ticket and set a task for eng-ml to test chunking.

oncall-bot: Reminder: overnight oncall rotation starts at 23:00 UTC. @Samir Patel is scheduled.

Priya Desai: Thanks — last two logistics bits: 1) small PR blocking the support instrumentation (#4125) still needs a review, pinging @Alex R. for a quick +1 if you can. 2) if anyone is taking handoff, drop a one-line summary here.

Alex R.: I'll review #4125 now, should be quick.

Ben Cole: taking handoff at 21:45 PT — leaving notes in the aggregate tickets: webhook auths -> Marta, embeddings aggregate -> eng-ml.

Priya Desai: awesome. if nothing else, I'm signing off in 10. leave any quick asks here or DM. :wave:
